protocol.scope: Source-only stationary-pitch/waveform inventory; no synthesis model or production constant fit. Public author sample WAVs are retained solely as ignored research references, without redistribution/commercial-clearance claim.
protocol.prior_information: Jon Jungle samplepacks page states C,Eb,G,Bb,C... ascending; patches page gives base99 and carrier multiplier1 for Saw Synth,Chiptune Esq,Synth Bass1. Effects are described to taste, not disabled; absolute octave/tuning and capture processing remain unknown.
protocol.selection: All three downloaded archives; inspect original WAV metadata before decoding and preserve original sample rate. Do not load a sampler or transpose files. All separable notes are inventoried, not selected for preferred pitch results.
protocol.measurement: First segment notes from20ms RMS frames: active threshold30dB below the90th-percentile RMS with at least60ms below threshold to separate; reject segments under150ms. Inspect segmentation as descriptive and record any override explicitly. Use central35..65percent of each segment as initial measurement window, cap at500ms centered and require120ms. Harmonic spacing via Hann periodogram/autocorrelation is descriptive; octave labels and pitch-class sequence require cross-check. No rate, patch, clock or ADC calibration inferred from filenames alone.
protocol.stationarity: For accepted note interiors compare three equal subwindows. Report frequency scatter; greater than1.5cents range is a nonstationary warning rather than precision clock evidence. Effects/gain/frequency can vary and source processing/retuning is undocumented.
protocol.discriminating_evidence: Relative semitone intervals and repeated octave ratios can constrain coarse note/multiplier behavior while one global unknown tuning cancels. Single-cycle/loop assets would constrain harmonic shape but not free-running phase or envelopes; archives currently list continuous WAVs only. No phase-reset, envelope-gate or clock-bit claim without additional evidence.
protocol.limits: Sample origin is author-reported. No raw SysEx, recorded MIDI, reference clock or sample-rate verification. Hidden factory fields may differ across siblings; free download is not permission to ship samples or claim commercial license. All failed/nonstationary/ambiguous notes remain in results.

independent_estimator_crosscheck.classification: Independent-estimator descriptive crosscheck after FFT inventory, not preregistered new-source holdout or model fit. Band center from first-pass nearest note; no fitted filter/phase alignment.
